compositions.title: agent-atoms v1 atom
compositions.description: A single atom in the agent-atoms catalog. Discriminated by `type`. agent-atoms personas overlap prompt-atoms personas but add agent-specific fields (memory, planner, supervisor).

persona_profile.description: Only for type=persona. Agent-specific role + planner + memory shape.

supervisor.description: Ref to an agent-atoms persona that supervises this one, or 'none'.

tool_spec.description: Only for type=tool-definition. JSON-schema-like tool signature.

audit.description: If true, every use is logged to the audit trail.

boundary.description: Only for type=role-boundary. Hard refusal rules.

escalate_to.description: Ref to a supervisor persona on refusal trigger.

isolation.description: Only for type=isolation-constraint. Process / network / fs isolation requirements.

compositions.title: agent-atoms v1 composition
compositions.description: An agent composition assembling persona + tools + capabilities + role boundaries + isolation into a complete agent definition.

compositions.title: Agent Context Envelope
compositions.description: Schema for the structured message envelope that defines the sole input to each agent. The envelope wraps a protocol message with authentication, persona context, and declared attachments. See governance/prompts/agent-protocol.md.

envelope.description: Envelope metadata for routing and audit.

message_id.description: Unique message identifier (msg- prefix + UUID v4).

correlation_id.description: Issue or PR identifier linking all messages in a work unit.

sender_persona.description: Persona that signed the message. Must match envelope.source_agent.

sender_task_id.description: Task ID of the sending agent in the orchestrator registry.

parent_message_id.description: Message ID of the parent message in the ASSIGN chain. Null for root messages.

session_id.description: Session ID for key derivation scope.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the canonical envelope content.

persona.description: Path to the persona definition file loaded for the target agent.

protocol_message.description: The actual agent protocol message (ASSIGN, RESULT, etc.).

context_attachments.description: Declared context files that the target agent is authorized to receive.

path.description: Path to the attachment file relative to repo root.

section.description: Optional section filter within the file (e.g., 'governance' for project.yaml).

compositions.title: agent-atoms v1 rule
compositions.description: A rule constrains how atoms and compositions can be combined. Examples: capability-grant, isolation-rule, communication-pattern, supervision-hierarchy.

compositions.title: doc-atoms v1 atom
compositions.description: A single atom in the doc-atoms catalog. Discriminated by `type`. doc-atoms holds explanatory documentation — tutorials, explanations, runbooks, how-tos, reference guides. Distinct from schema-atoms (normative specs and JSON Schemas).

audience.description: Who this document is for — e.g., operator, contributor, end-user, future-maintainer.

prerequisites.description: Refs to other doc-atoms or knowledge expected before reading.

body.description: The document content. Either inline markdown or a reference to a file in the repo.

path.description: Path relative to the atom file pointing at the body source.

tutorial_profile.description: Only for type=tutorial. Guided learning, opinionated path.

outcome.description: What the reader can do after finishing.

escalation.description: Whom to escalate to if the procedure fails.

how_to_profile.description: Only for type=how-to. Focused task answer.

compositions.title: doc-atoms v1 composition
compositions.description: A document composition — an assembled artifact (a learning path, a runbook collection, a multi-part reference guide) that references multiple doc-atoms.

compositions.title: key-atoms v1.1 atom (placeholder)
compositions.description: Placeholder permissive schema for the key/revocation/succession atom types under atoms-spec/v1.1.0. The full structured schema for the [key] block (key_id, algorithm, public_key, role, holder, issued_at, expires_at, succeeded_by) and the [[signatures]] array is deferred to schema-atoms and to a follow-up commit by the principal. CI uses this placeholder to validate JSON shape and required identity fields only; structural validation of the trust-bearing content happens out-of-band during the bootstrap period.

compositions.title: Panels Configuration
compositions.description: Schema for the `panels` list in a project.yaml AI configuration file. Panels are named review panels (code-review, security-review, threat-modeling, etc.) that the Olympus governance system runs on every change. Required panels are enforced by the active policy profile (default: code-review, security-review, threat-modeling, cost-analysis, documentation-review, data-governance-review).

oneOf.description: A panel slug or filename reference (with or without .md extension). Recognized slug values correspond to governance panel definitions in the active policy profile.
An inline panel configuration object when per-panel settings are needed.

enabled.description: Set false to disable this panel without removing it from the list.

required.description: Override the policy default; true means a failing verdict blocks merge.

threshold.description: Panel-level passing confidence threshold, overriding the policy default.

compositions.title: profile-atoms v1 profile
compositions.description: A profile is the durable composition a user activates to establish their working identity in the Olympus broker. Composes role-packs + policy stack + governance stack + defaults + availability sets + grounding sources.

trust_requirements.description: Per-atom-type trust gates. Keys: role_packs, policies, governance, identities, channels, knowledge, workflows, persona, theme. Values: signing requirements.

compositions.title: Project AI Configuration (project.yaml)
compositions.description: Schema for the project.yaml AI configuration file used across all convergent-systems-co repositories. Governs how Olympus, Claude Code, and related AI tooling behave in a project: language conventions, test commands, governance policy, review panels, and optional Azure DevOps integration.

name.description: Human-readable project name. Should match the repository slug.

language.description: Primary programming language (singular form). Use `languages` for multi-language repos.

languages.description: List of programming languages when the repo is multi-language.

framework.description: Primary framework. Use empty string or 'none' when not applicable.

personas.description: List of persona definition file paths (relative to repo root) activated for this project. Personas shape how AI agents reason and communicate.

panels.description: Review panels to run on every change. See panels-config schema for item shape.

paths.description: Canonical directory paths for AI-generated artifacts.

tooling.description: Build and quality tooling commands used by AI agents and CI.

test_command.description: Command to run the full test suite.

build_command.description: Command to produce the distributable artifact.

pre_commit.description: Whether pre-commit hooks are enabled in this repo.

lfs.description: Whether Git LFS is used in this repo.

conventions.description: Project-level coding, testing, style, and git conventions.

pr_template.description: Whether a PR body template is in use.

governance.description: Olympus governance settings for this project.

policy_profile.description: Named governance policy profile to apply.

parallel_tech_leads.description: Number of parallel tech-lead agents to spawn.

parallel_coders.description: Number of parallel coder agents to spawn.

require_worktree.description: Enforce that all work happens in a git worktree, never on the main working tree.

require_tdd.description: Enforce TDD writer before coder for every story.

llm_backend.description: LLM provider for governance pipeline agents.

use_project_manager.description: Whether to include a project-manager agent in the dispatch pipeline.

auto_merge.description: Enable GitHub auto-merge on PRs that pass all checks.

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Delete the source branch after a PR is merged.

enabled.description: Whether CODEOWNERS file enforcement is active.

provider.description: One or more issue tracking providers (comma-separated for multi-provider).

bidirectional.description: Sync in both directions when multiple providers are configured.

auth_secret_name.description: Name of the environment variable or secret holding the auth credential.

instructions.description: Free-form project-specific instructions injected into AI agent system prompts for this project.

project_name.description: Alternative project name field; some templates use `project_name` alongside `name`. Prefer `name`.

compositions.title: prompt-atoms v1 atom
compositions.description: A single atom in the prompt-atoms catalog. Discriminated by the top-level `type` field; one of: persona, constraint, format-instruction, tool-use-template, refusal-pattern, output-schema.

id.description: URL-safe slug; unique within the atom's type.

vendors.description: LLM families this atom is known to work well with. 'any' means vendor-agnostic.

content.description: The prompt fragment itself. For atoms with structured content (output-schema, tool-use-template), use the schema or template form; the renderer assembles it into a prompt turn.

applicable_turns.description: Which turns this atom legally appears in. Defaults to ['system'] for persona/constraint/format-instruction/refusal-pattern; ['tool'] for tool-use-template; ['system','assistant'] for output-schema.

see_also.description: Sibling atoms commonly composed with this one.

compositions.title: prompt-atoms v1 composition
compositions.description: A prompt composition assembling persona + constraints + format + tool-use + refusal patterns + output schema into a complete system message.

compositions.title: prompt-atoms v1 rule
compositions.description: A rule constrains how atoms and compositions can be combined. Examples: model-compatibility, token-length-constraint, format-compatibility.

compositions.title: theme-atoms v1 theme
compositions.description: A self-contained shell/terminal theme. Consumed by aish v0.2 via a single HTTP GET; no second fetch required for brand-atoms or any external reference.

schema.description: Pin the schema URI so consumers can verify they understand this version.

id.description: URL-safe slug; also the filename stem (id.toml).

version.description: Semver. Theme content changes bump version.

extends_brand.description: Documentary reference to a brand-atoms brand. NOT a fetch target — palette below MUST be inlined.

palette.description: Inlined palette. Keys are role names (e.g., fg, bg, green, blue, accent). Single-fetch contract: do not reference external palettes.

segments.description: Ordered list of segments to render. Unknown segments MUST be rejected by the consumer. See docs/elements.md for the data contract.

glyphs.description: Glyph set. nerd-default requires a Nerd Font.

roles.description: Semantic role → color mappings. Consumers look up runtime roles here (e.g., ai_tier_local).

syntax.description: Syntax-highlighting token → color mappings. Optional; consumers fall back to roles or defaults.

font.description: Preferred font for rendering this theme. A strong preference: aish-term / TUI consumers SHOULD match this font when available; plain CLI consumers MAY ignore. Users always retain a local override.

family.description: Primary font family. Should be a monospace font for prompt + segments to line up.

fallback.description: Ordered fallback chain. Consumer walks this list when the primary family is unavailable.

size.description: Point size (pt) hint. Consumer may scale.

ligatures.description: Enable programming ligatures (=> != etc). Requires a font that ships them.

nerd_font.description: Asserts the primary family is a Nerd Font patch. Required to be true when prompt.glyphs == 'nerd-default'.

layout.description: Compass layout: north (top), south (bottom), east (right), west (left) bars surround the always-present middle (the interactive terminal). Each bar holds named elements packed by alignment. Consumers render the bars they can; the middle is always rendered.

colorRef.description: Either a hex color (#RGB / #RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA) or a palette reference {palette.NAME} that MUST resolve within this theme's own palette block. No external references.

elementId.description: Element ID. Consumers map this to a renderer (data + glyph). Unknown elements MAY be skipped silently. See docs/elements.md for the full catalog and data contracts.

elementStyle.description: Per-element style override. Both fields optional; absent means 'use consumer default'.

icon.description: Glyph (or short string) to render in place of the element's default icon. Empty string disables the icon.

color.description: Text color override for this element (otherwise the bar's foreground applies).

elementsMap.description: Per-element style overrides keyed by element id. Lets a theme decide each element's icon + text color independently of the bar's bg/fg.

horizontalBar.description: A north or south bar. Elements pack into three alignment buckets.

verticalBar.description: An east or west bar. Renders as a vertical panel of given width. Elements pack into three alignment buckets.
